findings.source: OZ Initializable (ERC-7201 slot 0xf0c57e16840df040f15088dc2f81fe391c3923bec73e23a9662efc9c229c6a00): bool initialSetup = initialized == 0 && isTopLevelCall;
findings.issue: The ERC-7201 Initializable slot is printed factored by 3600 (P1) inside `stor[...]`, so this read of `_initialized` is not matched to the storage variable storF0C5 that names the same slot two words later; def storage also splits the uint64 `_initialized` into storF0C5 (uint8) and storF0C5_8 (uint56).
findings.rule: Never factor a storage-slot constant (or any 256-bit hash-like constant); resolve `stor[c]` to the named variable at slot c before printing; merge adjacent field splits when some access reads them together (here uint64(stor[c])).

notes: Spark UsdcVault (solc 0.8.21, UUPS). No explicit loop in the reached source; the 3 whiles are implicit (a 196-byte copy and two signature-bytes copies in the ERC-1271 permit path, P7). ERC-4626/permit/upgrade paths read correctly.
summary: Small loop-free vault with faithful text; one P1 factorisation hides an ERC-7201 storage slot and its variable name.
